source: Compiled build_graph with ContextualReviewer connected, and ContextualReviewer.review_graph

workflow.title: Resume matching: connected conversation workflow
workflow.description: Compiled conversation graph with local initial retrieval, detailed candidate assessment, comparative recommendations and persistent feedback.

__start__.title: START
__start__.subtitle: A new review
__start__.detail: A new conversation enters the compiled graph. Its review ID isolates the saved state.

parse_jd.title: Parse request
parse_jd.subtitle: Select the next action
parse_jd.detail: Interpret a job description or follow-up, select an action, and propose complete criteria. Clarification, tool requests, and review actions follow their declared branches.

extract_requirements.title: Extract requirements
extract_requirements.subtitle: Validate proposed criteria
extract_requirements.detail: Validate criteria and retain exact user conditions, examples and interpretation assumptions. Preserve unchanged meanings and evidence standards through refinements; compile new or changed meanings before candidate assessment. Keep uncommitted requirements separate until the new search succeeds.

search_resumes.title: Search resumes
search_resumes.subtitle: Retrieve from the corpus
search_resumes.detail: Search source windows with local dense and lexical retrieval. This step retrieves candidates; it does not use heuristic skill or duration gaps to reject candidates in the connected contextual workflow.

expand_search.title: Expand retrieval
expand_search.subtitle: Qwen3 full-resume ranking
expand_search.detail: Retrieve original passages for each criterion, then score every complete resume with the pinned Qwen3 Reranker 4B. Learned relevance determines the shortlist without a lexical score blend or an early candidate cut. This stage makes no per-candidate OpenAI call and no qualification decision.

rank_candidates.title: Rank candidates
rank_candidates.subtitle: Select ten provisional profiles
rank_candidates.detail: Select ten provisional candidates by retrieval relevance. Retain per-criterion passage leads and reserve candidate IDs. Do not infer eligibility, years or strengths. A changed requirement revision clears previous detailed findings and recommendations.

generate_report.title: Generate report
generate_report.subtitle: Render current state
generate_report.detail: Render the current screening findings, comparisons, questions, or error response from stored state. Keep source excerpts and unresolved evidence visible in the conversation.

human_feedback.title: Human feedback
human_feedback.subtitle: Save, pause, and resume
human_feedback.detail: A LangGraph interrupt pauses the conversation. A new message resumes the same review through its checkpoint and returns to request interpretation. The application uses durable SQLite checkpoints.

compare_candidates.title: Compare candidates
compare_candidates.subtitle: Explain the differences
compare_candidates.detail: Resolve candidate IDs and compare the available source evidence and current criterion findings. A comparison does not silently change the job requirements.

interview_questions.title: Interview questions
interview_questions.subtitle: Explicit request after review
interview_questions.detail: On request, prepare candidate-specific questions from evidence gaps and reported work, with follow-ups and assessment guidance.

file_tool.title: File tools
file_tool.subtitle: Read, list, search, write
file_tool.detail: Use the inherited hardened filesystem tools. Reads stay inside the project; generated reports are written inside the designated report directory.

deep_screen.title: Detailed screening
deep_screen.subtitle: Review source evidence
deep_screen.detail: Run the first full-source qualification assessment on up to ten candidates. Extract and audit work records, assess requirements and useful context, calculate dates locally, then audit evidence. Publish completed and pending records with candidate progress.

final_screen.title: Recommendations
final_screen.subtitle: Decision policy + audited memo
final_screen.detail: Check completed evidence and derive advance, hold or no-hire boundaries. Generate a cohort memo with comparisons, justified priority groups and decision contingencies. Audit its claims against reviewed facts and frozen requirements before publishing. No full-resume reassessment.

finish_review.title: Complete review
finish_review.subtitle: Record human completion
finish_review.detail: An explicit completion request ends this conversation workflow while preserving the saved screening report and its evidence.

__end__.title: END
__end__.subtitle: Review complete
__end__.detail: The human reviewer explicitly completed this workflow.

review.title: Contextual reviewer: detailed evidence review
review.description: Actual nested graph: extract and audit work records, assess requirements and work context, then audit the proposed findings while retaining unresolved disputes.

__start__.title: START
__start__.subtitle: Detailed review begins
__start__.detail: The nested graph receives a source packet for one candidate and the current frozen criteria. It does not contain a separate human interrupt.

extract_and_audit_work_history.title: Prepare work records
extract_and_audit_work_history.subtitle: Source extraction + audit
extract_and_audit_work_history.detail: Extract and separately audit the complete source inventory within detailed screening. Preserve all employment, source IDs and dates. Reuse these source-only records on later requests; they are never required for initial retrieval.

assess_requirements.title: Assess requirements
assess_requirements.subtitle: Criteria and work observations
assess_requirements.detail: Assess the frozen criteria against source-linked work records. Return criterion findings, positive date associations and useful work observations together. Code calculates experience. No questions or recommendations.

audit_evidence.title: Audit final evidence
audit_evidence.subtitle: Source, dates and claim checks
audit_evidence.detail: Check the draft criteria, positive duration links, endpoints and observations against the full source and frozen standard. Remove rejected links before local arithmetic. A support-status disagreement remains uncertain with both judgments retained; agreed support can retain a narrative correction. Return the source-bound assessment and explicit disputes.

__end__.title: END
__end__.subtitle: Return reviewed evidence
__end__.detail: Return the nested review state to detailed screening. The outer graph generates the report and waits for human feedback.
